experiment: conditional Monte Carlo for exact four-round S-box characteristic under one fixed Midori64 master key
round1_and_2_probability: 2^-6 (exact for this key, based on conforming triples)
experimental_method: force the three active round-1 S-boxes to conform, sample other initial nibbles uniformly, check rounds 3 and 4; reported values account for conditioning
scope: Monte Carlo for one chosen key, not an analytic probability evaluation or a statement about the proportion of all compatible keys
